implementation_foundation: Radix/ShadCN Avatar (Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback primitives). Size is passed via React context from the Avatar root to AvatarFallback for correct font sizing.

anatomy: fallback-initials (shown when no image — 1 or 2 letters)

fallback-initials.note: font.label.badge description explicitly mentions avatar initials ('USE THIS for badges, tags, pills, avatar initials and tooltip text. 12px/16px Regular.')

font/size.note: Confirmed: --p-font-size-h7: 12px exists in CSS. Reuses same value as --c-tooltip-font-size.

required_attributes: alt (on image — full name, or empty if decorative)
aria-label (on container if image has empty alt)

usage_rules: Use small (16px) for dense contexts: table cells, inline references.
Use medium (24px) for standard UI contexts: lists, cards, assignment fields.
Use large (32px) for prominent contexts: profile headers, comment threads.
Always show Initials fallback when no image URL is available — never show a broken image.
Initials should be the first letter of first and last name (max 2 characters).
anti_patterns: Do not use a square or rounded-rect container — always full radius (circle).
Do not scale the avatar with CSS width/height overrides outside the approved size set — use the size prop.
Do not show avatar without a fallback state.
